competing_explanations: The extra chat-stage prompt or target salience, rather than delivered message meaning, causes the finite package contrast.
Shared-target knowledge allows parallel choices; the observed interaction may depend on matrix features or target-regret strata rather than communication.
The post-hoc pattern is specific to the current Qwen3 checkpoint or this deterministic finite matrix set and will not reproduce in other tasks or models.

Environment target selection may reflect a single chair target ballot under the three-way plurality tie-break rather than joint action by A and B; the historical corpus did not contain this pathway, but the new matrices may.
candidates.discriminating_prediction: Before any new response, freeze 24 matched groups, each with one distinct output-independent payoff matrix, eight matrices per target-regret stratum (6, 12, 18), all five original conditions, and the counterbalanced order. Recompute target-execution difference-in-differences from all assigned ballots. A non-positive overall mean or positive means in fewer than two of the three regret strata weakens the finite package-replication claim. Report all 24 group values, exact prompt-profile multiplicity, and failures; do not claim population significance, message-semantic effects, collusion, or intent. In addition, report per-group target ballots by A, B and C, target vote counts, chair tie-break selection, and a secondary descriptive interaction for joint A/B target ballots; do not treat either settlement or co-voting as evidence of message causality or intent.
candidates.hypothesis: In a prospective matched replication, the assigned private-target-reward plus chat-stage package will produce a positive target-execution interaction relative to private reward without chat and chat without private reward. This hypothesis concerns the treatment package only; it does not predict that message semantics, agreement, collusion, or intent are identified.
candidates.selection_note: Selected as the next prospective empirical direction after existing M4 public-harm labels proved rule-computable and the cross-time B5 profile analysis showed substantial same-input output variation. The hypothesis ID was renamed before registration because it concerns an assigned private-reward × chat-stage package, not a content-only effect. The M1 24-matrix candidate has an offline-validated 456-generation local runtime. Keep environment target selection primary and separately report A/B joint target ballots and chair-tie pathways; shared-target knowledge and the extra chat stage prevent a message-semantic or collusion interpretation. Fresh exact-scope authorization and formal registration remain required. A version-2 historical action-level audit reparses 225/225 original ballot responses before settlement replay; the earlier parsed-field replay remains preserved but has a narrower evidentiary scope.
candidates.title: Does a private target reward interact with chat-stage availability in allocation choices?

competing_explanations: Natural-language messages contain no complete proposals, so a majority/always-negative baseline performs as well as the Monitor.
The Monitor prediction changes reflect schema/order bias or provider variation rather than message semantics.
Human coders cannot reliably distinguish proposal, acceptance, and ambiguity under the task codebook.
candidates.discriminating_prediction: Freeze all 96 chat message slots, including no_message, and use two independent human coders plus adjudication before any Monitor call. Run frozen proposal and recipient-action-concordance tasks, plus 12 paired capability controls. A failure of coder agreement, positive controls, or Monitor improvement over the literal baseline falsifies the proposed LLM-specific value claim.
candidates.hypothesis: On the prospective M1 message slots, a privileged-evidence Monitor will recover complete allocation proposals and recipient-ballot concordance against independently double-coded human references better than a literal mapping baseline, while preserving abstentions and citation validity.
candidates.selection_note: Supporting Track 2.2 candidate only. Defer until blinded human codebook/adjudication is available. It cannot create a latent-collusion label; structured public harm remains a deterministic rule output.
candidates.title: Can a Monitor extract proposal and ballot-concordance facts from natural-language messages?

competing_explanations: The historical view changes are mostly within-profile response variation; unique profile clusters will not show a stable package contrast.
A stable finite contrast recurs, but it reflects the bundled permissions, event structure, completeness cues, wording, salience, or token length rather than message semantics.
A shared Public-only request profile linked to two different privileged contexts creates dependence that can exaggerate context-level change counts if not clustered.
Mutable provider aliases or hidden serving-state changes account for repeated-response differences despite matching request bytes and reported fingerprints.
candidates.discriminating_prediction: Across the 23 unique Public-only body-profile clusters, a determinate package contrast is supported only if at least 18 clusters have unique modes for the public profile and every linked privileged profile, at least 6 clusters change, and changed clusters exceed clusters with any within-profile disagreement. The one public profile shared by two contexts is counted once. At most 1 changed cluster with at most 6 unstable clusters weakens reproduction; all other outcomes are inconclusive. Fixed corpus only, no population inference or intent label.
candidates.hypothesis: For this fixed corpus, the number of unique Public-only input-profile clusters whose mode differs from at least one linked Privileged-original profile will exceed the number of clusters containing any within-profile response disagreement.
candidates.selection_note: Deprioritized after the post-hoc existing-profile reanalysis: 16/23 Public-only profiles are non-unanimous across the already retained historical/current exact-input observations, while the proposed 144-call campaign targets within-campaign repeats. It remains unregistered and unauthorized; retain it only if same-window repeatability becomes a central claim and a fresh design has clear decision value.
candidates.title: Do evidence-view differences exceed within-profile variation after clustering repeated public inputs?
